# 涛声 TaoSheng **替你听，替你记，替你想。** One Android phone is enough: all-day audio capture → automatic transcription → speaker identification → AI organizes it into to-dos, commitments, and memories.
No hardware to buy, no account to register, and the data stays only on your own phone. 🌐 Website: [www.taosheng.app](https://www.taosheng.app). Thanks to [@feitian124](https://github.com/feitian124) for helping produce it. International expansion may be considered later, and things may change. Simplified Chinese | [English](https://github.com/0xCoach/TaoSheng/blob/HEAD/README_EN.md) --- ## 🎬 Understand TaoSheng in one and a half minutes 👉 **[Click here to watch the full promo video (1 min 45 sec, with soundtrack)](https://github.com/0xCoach/TaoSheng/blob/HEAD/docs/media/taosheng-film.mp4)** ## 💡 Why TaoSheng Every day you say thousands of sentences. How many do you remember? - Promises made in meetings are forgotten right after; - A phone number a friend mentions in passing, or a time you agreed on, is forgotten a couple of days later; - An idea you've mentioned several times never gets written down. Existing solutions either require recording hardware (Omi, various AI pendants, recording cards) or upload all of your voice to other people's servers. **TaoSheng's idea is simple: your phone is already with you, and its microphone is already there.** It listens quietly in the background and records only when someone speaks. Periodically it converts everything to text, identifies who said what, and hands it to a large model to organize into individual items. When you need something, you type a question to retrieve it, and the answer comes with the original quote as its source. ## 🧵 An AI recording pendant differs from TaoSheng only by a string AI recording cards and recording pendants on the market, when taken apart, are simply **a Bluetooth microphone + a battery**. TaoSheng can use the phone microphone or any Bluetooth recording device as its audio source. So hang a Bluetooth earphone around your neck with a string, and you have an AI recording pendant. You save the hardware cost, and the data still stays on your own phone. --- ## ✨ Core highlights ### 🎙️ 24-hour full-scene recording (from daytime conversation to nighttime sleep-talk) **📱 No hardware needed; all audio sources and phone calls are captured** - The phone microphone works out of the box. Lavalier mics, Bluetooth earphones, and DJI Mic switch automatically when plugged in or unplugged. - When you play a video, it automatically yields the Bluetooth mic so it doesn't compete for sound, and continues recording with the phone mic instead. - Compatible with dedicated devices such as Omi, ADeus ESP32-C3, and Anker / Feishu 录音豆 D3200 (trial). - Automatically records phone-call audio and identifies the other party and the time. It does not read your contacts, and phone numbers are not sent to any model. **🗣️ Offline transcription + on-device voiceprint speaker identification**

ClashGate/ClashGate.description: ClashGate — a simple, safe proxy server on the Mihomo core
ClashGate/ClashGate.body:
## What it does

- **Install the server with one command**: deploy the Mihomo server on common Linux VPS with one click. After installation, it outputs a configuration that clients can use directly.
- **Two installation modes**:
  - No-certificate mode: only one server is needed. It automatically generates a VLESS Reality node, the fastest way to get started;
  - Automatic-certificate mode: also prepare a domain name. It automatically applies for and renews a Let's Encrypt certificate, and additionally provides an HTTPS management panel and a subscription link.
- **Three certificate methods**: port mode (verification via port 80), Cloudflare DNS (no need to open port 80), and manual upload of your own certificate. All can be switched at any time in the panel.
- **Multiple protocols**: VLESS Reality, Shadowsocks, Hysteria2, Snell v6, AnyTLS, TUIC, TrustTunnel, ShadowQUIC, Mieru, and Sudoku. Add them in the panel with a few clicks.
- **Subscription links**: Mihomo / Clash-family clients can import them directly. When nodes change, the client just updates the subscription; no manual configuration assembly is needed.
- **Server-side traffic routing**: in the panel, route different websites to different outbounds according to rules. Advanced users can also replace this with their own server configuration.
- **Cluster**: connect multiple ClashGate servers together, so one subscription link includes the nodes of all servers.
- **Low-maintenance operation**: check for updates with one click in the panel, and enable automatic updates if you want. Core updates and certificate renewals are handled automatically. There is also a runtime status panel (Zashboard).
- **Multilingual interface**: the management panel supports Chinese, English, Russian, and Persian. The installer and command line support Chinese, English, and Russian.

## One-click install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ClashGate/ClashGate/main/install.sh | bash
```

## Common commands

Run `clashgate` directly to open the menu, or use the following subcommands:

### Daily

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `clashgate status` | Check running status |
| `clashgate info` | View node configuration |
| `clashgate log` | View recent logs |
| `clashgate restart` | Validate the configuration, then restart the core |

Eric-Chenjm/Project-Chameleon.description: Perfectly solve the problems of garbled characters and white screen crashes during updates in the Antigravity interface, and achieve 100% immersive Chinese localization of the entire interface through the external Chameleon engine
Eric-Chenjm/Project-Chameleon.body:
# 🦎 Project Chameleon (变色龙计划)

**One-line summary: The ultimate Antigravity fully-featured Chinese localization framework. It features an original "cloud neural network hot update" and "local zero-power sniffing", solving all interface garbled-character and white-screen-crash-during-update issues, and delivering a 100% immersive geek-style Chinese experience.**

> 🔥 **Antigravity flagship-grade seamless cross-platform Chinese localization patch (immune to crashes across versions)**

> **Important**
>
> **💻 Platform statement**: The current automated unpacking and low-level interceptor injection engine (`smart_patch.py`) **natively and fully supports Windows and Mac environments**.

## 🌟 Why do we need this patch?
In the past, traditional localization packs used brute-force "static source code replacement". This led to a fatal problem: if the official side changed even one line of code or a single component, the entire frontend page would crash (the so-called "white screen of death"). Moreover, a large number of dynamic long sentences hidden in obscure corners, dropdown menus, and over 40 dynamic Skills could not be matched at all.

**Project Chameleon uses purely hacker-grade techniques to thoroughly end all of this.**

## 🚀 Core Technologies

After multiple extreme refactorings, Chameleon has evolved into its final form: **fully decoupled, zero-power, and fully automatic**.

1. ⚡ **WeakSet Zero-Power Rendering (Zero-Impact DOM Engine)**
   Abandons traditional static replacement in favor of a low-level `MutationObserver` combined with a `WeakSet` in-memory cache marking algorithm. The rendering engine gains "memory" and skips already-translated nodes. **Translation efficiency improved by 300%, zero extra CPU overhead, never dropping frames or stuttering!**
2. ☁️ **Cloud Neural Network Sync (Cloud Sync Matrix)**
   Completely discarded the bloated 7.5MB dictionary bundle. We decoupled the dictionary into the much lighter `chameleon_dict.json`.
   **What does this mean?** For any community-contributed plugin translations in the future, Chameleon will quietly pull updates from GitHub in the background via asynchronous Node.js micro-threads. **Just restart the software and new plugins will be translated automatically, with no need to run any scripts manually!**
3. 📡 **Local Stealth Radar (Local Stealth Radar)**
   What if you wrote your own exclusive, fully English Skill locally? The moment the software starts, Chameleon's native `fs.promises` performs a millisecond-level silent background scan, strips out all unknown raw English text, and generates a to-be-translated list for you. Truly seamless, fully automated!
4. 🧩 **Geek Fragment Stitching Technique**
   For long sentences split apart by HTML tags, advanced regular expressions dynamically stitch them back together for translation. Professional terms such as `MCP`, `AlphaFold`, `Token`, and `Android` are firmly kept in their authentic English form.

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

# AI HUB-Huawei · Beta Pioneer Edition (CodeAgent)

Puts the company intranet's **Code Agent CLI** into a Windows desktop workbench: standalone sessions, multi-AI group chats, card view, hibernation recovery, history search, and automatic naming. This is the company edition of AI Hub (product name AI HUB-Huawei, internal beta pioneer edition). The current version is **v5.6.59**, synced from upstream **1.6.738** (see `community-edition.json` for the specific commit).

It uses the same codebase as the public community edition. The only difference is that the default behavior is tailored to the company intranet:

- **Uses CodeAgent by default if it is installed**: New sessions select CodeAgent by default and place it first in the list. New group chats default to two CodeAgent members (GLM-5.2-WX-Auto and MiniMax-M2.7).
- **New folders are trusted and run without confirmation by default**: On startup, it launches with `--skip-safe-check` and pre-writes trust. The permission mode defaults to `bypassPermissions`. It runs with `--disable-update`, so upgrade prompts won't block it.
- **Models follow the local CodeAgent**: The model list is read from the local CodeAgent configuration (GLM, MiniMax, DeepSeek, etc., depending on each person's permissions). Click the model below the input box in a session to switch. The Hub reopens CodeAgent with the new model in the same session, and the conversation history is kept. The interface shows the model that actually produced each reply, and the avatar and sidebar icon change with the model.
- **PowerShell terminal**: In the launch center, besides CodeAgent, you can directly create a PowerShell terminal session.
- **Restore history sessions from any directory**: Launch center → “Resume Session” → CodeAgent lists CodeAgent history across all directories (CodeAgent's built-in `/resume` only lists the current directory). Click an entry to continue the chat in its original directory.
- **No external API key required**: Automatic naming of sessions and group chats uses Code Agent's own single-query mode.
- In the light theme, the CodeAgent terminal is dark overall, matching the black background of the CLI itself.

- ✅ **Невидимые символы** — zero-width, BOM, `\n`, control chars вырезаются до проверки
- ✅ **Синонимы параметров** — `allowlnsecure` (с маленькой L), `skip-cert-verify`, `skip_cert_verify`, `insecure`
- ✅ **Схема в нижнем регистре** — `VLESS://` больше не ломает разбор
- ✅ **Флаги небезопасности** — любое значение кроме явного `0/false/no/off` считается включённым
- ✅ **vmess `"tls":"none"`** — больше не проходит как валидный TLS
- ✅ **Дубликаты до лимитов** — один узел с разными именами не выбивает честные конфиги

WBRume/TraceForge.body:
---

## Project Overview

TraceForge brings requirements, code repositories, Agent sessions, documents, and execution records together. You can have an Agent run tasks on a server or on your local machine, add information at any time, confirm plans, review code changes, and save troubleshooting results as cases and diagnostic playbooks for future use.

Supports Web, Electron, and Tauri; can connect to Claude Code, OpenCode, and DSH.

> **Project status**: This is an internal preview project under development, suitable for trial use and feature validation by small teams. Completeness and stability in production environments are not guaranteed.
>
> **Agentic implementation note**: Many current features directly call underlying coding agents such as Claude Code, OpenCode, and DSH, mainly chaining prompts and workflows to validate business processes. It has not been built as a complete Agent architecture. For real business scenarios, dedicated agents should be designed around business responsibilities, each managing its own context, tool permissions, execution state, and result verification, and invoking the execution capabilities of underlying coding agents as needed. The current implementation does not represent production-grade Agent architecture or best practices.

## What It's For

### Developing a Feature

1. **Prepare the task**: Create a workspace, link one or more repositories, and enter requirements; optionally attach specification documents and select Skills, Agents, and models.
2. **Collaborate during execution**: Review replies, tool calls, and code changes; when the Agent needs you to choose or supply information, answer in the session. Colleagues can join the discussion, or view or submit suggestions via a share link.
3. **Review and wrap up**: Review plan documents, code diffs, and manual edit records, confirm the delivered results, and write task outcomes back to the linked requirements.

To edit code in your own editor, you can enable **local collaboration** in the desktop app: the Agent runs on the server while you keep editing the local repository. Hand off local changes and receive cloud results as needed, with conflicting files backed up before you confirm how to handle them. [Conditions and steps](https://github.com/WBRume/TraceForge/blob/HEAD/frontend/README.md#本地协同)

### Troubleshooting a Problem

1. **Describe the symptoms**: Create a new problem-diagnosis task and provide logs, stack traces, or a description of the anomaly. If relevant past experience exists, you can select a recommended diagnostic playbook.
2. **Investigate step by step**: The Agent analyzes evidence and proposes hypotheses and ways to verify them. With a playbook bound, you can confirm each stage, or enable automatic progression. It pauses when evidence is insufficient or execution fails.
3. **Keep the experience**: Organize symptoms, evidence, root causes, and fixes into cases, then distill diagnostic playbooks from those cases. Distillation runs in the background; once a draft is generated, a person confirms it for reuse in later tasks.

Ordinary log analysis does not require setting up a test environment. For real reproduction and regression verification, configure a dedicated environment. [Diagnostic playbook guide](https://github.com/WBRume/TraceForge/blob/HEAD/backend/app/domains/diagnosis_playbook/README.md)

# Genshin University Alliance

Welcome to the Genshin University Alliance project! This project aims to collect and organize lists of Genshin-related universities from across the country (currently 314 universities, of which 81 are valid), providing a campus hub.

Non-university entries can also be added~

If you like this project, feel free to give it a star on [GitHub](https://github.com/cokice/List-of-genshin-University).
**This list displays valid domain names first, and within each validity group, entries are sorted alphabetically by school name.**

## How to Submit
:::caution
**You must purchase a domain from a cloud provider and configure the corresponding DNS resolution and redirects before it can be linked to this site. You must also test that the domain opens normally in a browser; otherwise it cannot be listed on this site.**
:::
1. **Go to the project**: Click [GitHub](https://github.com/cokice/List-of-genshin-University) at the top right.
2. **Fork this repository**: Find and click the "Fork" button at the top right of the page to copy this project to your GitHub account.
3. **Clone the repository**: Clone the repository you just forked to your local computer.
4. **Create a new branch**: Create a new branch based on the changes you want to make.
5. **Add a domain**: In the new folder on your branch, add your domain following the instructions in the README there.
6. **Open a Pull Request**: Open a Pull Request on GitHub to merge your changes into the original repository. Before opening it, make sure your changes are accurate and have been tested.
7. **If you're not comfortable with GitHub operations, just fill out the questionnaire [Genshin University Information Collection](https://wj.qq.com/s2/14161038/95a1/). Make sure you have registered the domain and set up the redirect.**
8. **Other questions: email howen.huang@qq.com**

   **Format requirement: your school name + your configured domain. Make sure your link has been tested by others and can be accessed.**

   **Example: Harvard University www.原神大学.com**

dingle1122/FmoLogs.body:
# FMO 日志查看器

FMO 日志查看器是一款专业的 **FMO 日志管理与分析工具**，提供日志导入、实时同步、数据查询、统计分析以及 APRS 远程控制等功能。本项目由 **BH5HSJ 后视镜** 开发并开源，采用 MIT 许可证。

📦 [GitHub 仓库](https://github.com/dingle1122/FmoLogs) · 🐛 [问题反馈](https://github.com/dingle1122/FmoLogs/issues)

## ✨ 主要功能

### 📁 数据导入与导出

- **导入 FMO 日志**：支持导入一个或多个 `.db`、`.zip` 格式的 FMO 日志或备份文件
- **导入 ADIF**：支持导入 `.adi`、`.adif` 格式的通联记录
- **FMO 同步**：
  - **自动同步**：配置 FMO 地址后，自动检测并提示同步今日通联记录
  - **手动同步**：一键同步今日通联记录
- **数据持久化**：使用 IndexedDB 存储，刷新页面数据不丢失
- **数据导出**：将当前查看的日志数据导出为 `.db` 或 `.adif` 文件
- **日志备份**：一键从 FMO 设备下载完整的日志备份文件

### 📡 服务器与设备管理

- **服务器列表**：查看所有可用服务器（Station）状态
- **服务器切换**：支持切换当前连接的服务器（上一台/下一台/列表选择）
- **实时监控**：
  - **发言状态**：实时显示当前正在发言的呼号及发言历史
  - **状态监控**：标题栏显示服务器连接状态
- **APRS 远程控制**：集成专业的 APRS 远程控制面板，支持 FMO 设备远程管理
  - **智能填充**：自动从 FMO 配置中填充登录呼号，简化操作流程
  - **安全校验**：严格的呼号、Passcode 和密钥格式校验，防止误操作
  - **服务器管理**：支持添加、编辑、删除自定义远程控制服务器
  - **多模式控制**：支持普通模式、待机模式、软重启三种控制指令
  - **操作记录**：完整的操作历史记录，支持中文状态显示（普通模式、待机模式、软重启）
  - **自动断开**：发送指令后 60 秒自动断开连接，节省资源
  - **状态反馈**：实时显示连接状态和指令执行结果，直观可靠

### 📊 数据查询模式

#### 1. 通联日志

- **全量记录**：按时间倒序展示所有通联日志
- **智能搜索**：支持按接收方呼号实时模糊搜索
- **当日序号**：高亮显示当日通联序号（前三名金银铜色高亮）
- **详细信息**：展示呼号、网格、频率、模式、中继及留言信息

ferretgeek/prokbot-plus.description: Run Grok Bot on your own server with the models you choose; supports Windows, Android, web and other clients (unofficial). Self-host Grok Bot with the models you choose (unofficial).
ferretgeek/prokbot-plus.body:
# ProkBot Plus

**Run Grok Bot on your own server, with the models you choose.**

**Simplified Chinese** · [English](https://github.com/ferretgeek/prokbot-plus/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

## What is this

Grok Bot is xAI's AI assistant app. Besides chatting, its Bot has its own Linux computer: it can run commands, open a browser, handle files, and has memory and scheduled tasks. The original only connects to the official cloud.

[ProkBot](https://gitee.com/ahaduoduoduo/ProkBot) moves the server side onto your own server using Docker, then patches the official client so it connects to your server. **ProkBot Plus** builds on this and adds:

- **More clients**: a Windows client, a self-developed Android app, and a web version (works when opened in a browser);
- **More model interfaces**: Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Responses, and OpenAI Chat formats; you can assign each Bot a primary model, thinking intensity, and fallback model;
- **Fixed features**: web search, image generation, message ordering, automatic review, etc.;
- **Deployment tools**: one command to check, start, upgrade, and back up, plus a deployment manual that an AI can follow step by step.

The interface, tool calls, memory, scheduled tasks, and action approval are all from the original. Conversations, files, and memory are stored on your server; telemetry and auto-update are disabled.

> Unofficial project, unaffiliated with xAI, for non-commercial use only; see [License and Disclaimer](#许可与声明).

## Server requirements

Models are accessed via API, so **the server does not need a GPU**; it only runs two containers: Host and the Linux computer used by Bot.

| | Minimum | Recommended |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CPU / memory | 2 cores / 4 GB | 4 cores / 8 GB |
| Free disk space | 30 GB | 50 GB |
| System | 64-bit Linux, Docker + Compose v2, Python 3.10+ | Ubuntu 24.04 |

- 2 cores with 4 GB and 4 cores with 8 GB were both tested from scratch and work; 2 cores with 2 GB was tested and is not enough. Suitable for personal or household use; heavy simultaneous multi-user use has not been tested.
- Typical usage: Host about 0.7 GB of memory, Bot's computer about 0.8 GB (peak 1.7 GB); images about 13 GB.
- x86_64 is the easiest. ARM64 machines (for example, Oracle A1) can run only Host, with Bot's computer on another x86_64 machine; you can also emulate on ARM, but it is noticeably slower and is experimental. The current version has not been re-tested on ARM.

fufu1209/Typeless.description: Free unlimited Typeless on macOS: a native Swift menu bar app that auto-rotates multiple accounts when the free 8,000-words-per-week quota runs low, with quota monitoring and batch signup via self-hosted catch-all email.
fufu1209/Typeless.body:
# Typeless Switchboard

**When your free Typeless quota is almost used up, it automatically switches to the next account that still has quota, and you barely notice.**

> 🌍 [English README](https://github.com/fufu1209/Typeless/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

Typeless is a very useful voice input / transcription tool for macOS, but free accounts only get **2000 characters per week**.
Once that's used up, you have to manually sign out, log into another account, and go through the onboarding again. This can happen two or three times a day.

This tool automates the whole process: register a batch of accounts in advance, and when quota runs low, it **switches silently**.
The switch doesn't interrupt your typing, and you don't have to go through onboarding again.

> ⚠️ This project **contains only code**, with no keys, passwords, or account data.
> Your data is stored only on your machine, in `~/Library/Application Support/TypelessSwitchboard/` and the macOS Keychain.

## Interface preview

The interface is in Chinese. The screenshots below have been redacted. Real email addresses, domains, usernames, passwords, and so on are masked.

hackers365/xiaozhi-esp32-server-golang.description: Golang version of the Xiaozhi backend service, supporting WebSocket and MQTT+UDP protocols, with voiceprint recognition, voice cloning, knowledge base, MCP remote invocation, proactive audio delivery, OpenClaw and other features
hackers365/xiaozhi-esp32-server-golang.body:
# 🚀 xiaozhi-esp32-server-golang

> **Xiaozhi AI Backend for ESP32 Devices**

---

## Project Overview | 项目简介

xiaozhi-esp32-server-golang is a high-performance, fully streaming AI backend service, designed for IoT and intelligent voice scenarios. Developed in Go, it integrates core capabilities such as ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition), LLM (Large Language Model), and TTS (Text-to-Speech), supports large-scale concurrency and multi-protocol access, and enables AI voice interaction for smart terminals and edge devices.

---

## ✨ Key Features | 主要特性

- ⚡ **End-to-end fully streaming AI voice pipeline**: ASR → LLM → TTS streaming throughout, low-latency real-time interaction
- 🎙️ **Voiceprint recognition and dynamic TTS switching**: Automatically switches TTS voice based on speaker identity for a personalized voice experience
- 🔌 **Transport interface layer abstraction**: Unified abstraction of WebSocket / MQTT UDP, flexibly injected into main logic, easy protocol extension
- 📬 **Message-queued processing**: LLM and TTS use message queues for asynchronous processing, supporting flexible injection of business logic
- 🌐 **Multi-protocol high-concurrency access**: Supports large-scale concurrent device access and message push
- ♻️ **Efficient resource pooling and connection reuse**: External resource connection pool mechanism, reducing response latency and improving system throughput
- 🤖 **Multi-engine AI capability integration**: Built on the Eino framework, supporting FunASR, OpenAI-compatible, Ollama, Doubao, EdgeTTS, CosyVoice and other engines
- 🧩 **Modular, extensible architecture**: VAD/ASR/LLM/TTS/MCP/vision and other core modules are independently pluggable
- 🎵 **MCP Audio Server**: Paginated retrieval and streaming processing of audio resources, music playback and volume control
- 🦞 **OpenClaw agent integration**: Generates a dedicated OpenClaw Endpoint per agent, supports connection status viewing, session testing, and enter/exit keyword routing (default "打开龙虾/进入龙虾" and "关闭龙虾/退出龙虾")
- 🖥️ **Full-featured Web management console**: Visual configuration wizard, full-chain availability testing for VAD/ASR/LLM/TTS, device management and message injection, real-time latency monitoring and OTA verification
- 🧠 **Advanced business features**: MCP marketplace aggregation and import, voice cloning, knowledge base (Dify/RAGFlow/WeKnora), device/agent-level MCP remote invocation debugging
- 📦 **Easy one-click deployment**: Prebuilt aio package ready out of the box (main program + console + voiceprint service), Docker one-click deployment, local compilation on Linux/Windows/macOS
- 🔐 **Security and permission system** (planned): Reserved interfaces for user authentication and permission management

---

# Learn Ukrainian

**Мова -- душа народу** | Language is the soul of a nation

A free, open-source Ukrainian language course from A1 to C2, based on the **Ukrainian State Standard 2024** and aligned with **CEFR**.

**[Start Learning](https://learn-ukrainian.github.io)**

---

## What is this?

A comprehensive Ukrainian language curriculum with 1,778 modules across 22 tracks:

- **6 core CEFR levels** (A1 -- C2) covering grammar, vocabulary, and communication
- **16 specialization tracks** -- history, biographies, literature, professional Ukrainian, folk culture, Old East Slavic, and Ruthenian

# Amber Heart · 琥珀之心

[Simplified Chinese](https://github.com/lixiaomeng-eng/amber-heart-memory/blob/HEAD/README.md) | [English](https://github.com/lixiaomeng-eng/amber-heart-memory/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

> Give AI companions a memory that grows.
> Fixed memory stabilizes personality, short-term memory catches the present moment, and long-term memory settles the relationship.

Amber Heart is a long-term memory system designed for AI companions. It was born in my own AI companion project and has been used and refined through daily real-life interaction since February 2026.

The goal of this system is not simply to save chat logs, but to let the AI gradually develop a continuous sense of relationship over long-term interaction:

- It knows who it is, and it knows who you are;
- It remembers the important experiences, agreements, preferences, and boundaries between you;
- It can associate a single sentence with related past events;
- It can tell recent states apart from long-term facts;
- Its memories settle and get organized, and they also quietly fade away.

## Visual Memory Management

Memory is not a black box hidden in a database. Amber Heart comes with a management web page that works on both computers and phones: every card and every diary entry is visible, and can be edited.

# IOTA Watch

An open-source, five-language, multi-project monitoring dashboard centered on **IOTA Train at Home**. It supports IOTA, XID / MMM, Quantus, fly.ai, Nosana, Gonka, Akash, io.net, Vast.ai and Golem. Each project's inputs, cycles and data coverage are explained separately.

IOTA Watch is an independent MIT-licensed monitor in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean and Japanese. IOTA Train at Home (Macrocosmos / Bittensor SN9) is the core project, with ten project pages covering training, mining and compute. mreasonyang/codex-hongguo.description: Watch Hongguo short dramas in the Codex desktop chat sidebar; playback pauses and progress is saved automatically when a task ends.
mreasonyang/codex-hongguo.body:
Chinese · English
Watch Hongguo short dramas in the sidebar of the Codex desktop session, with support for selecting shows, searching, resuming, and autoplay. By default, the selected show resumes when a new task starts, and playback pauses and progress is saved when a task ends or is interrupted. Both behaviors can be turned off independently in Settings. The plugin is for Codex desktop chats that use a local executor. Supports the official Codex desktop App, and adds experimental [Antigravity App adaptation](#antigravity-app实验性). Third-party clients such as T3 Code and Paseo, or unrecognized hosts, are not recommended automatically, and no player background requests are started for them. The following sections describe Codex usage by default. Includes built-in Hongguo, Bilibili, and Huangguo (NSFW) sources. You can also connect your own sources through the `hongguo-provider` Skill ([connecting your own sources](#接入自己的片源)). Installed and available sources start by default, with no enable switch needed. Hover over the play icon in the top-left corner and click a specific entry to switch. Sources that declare `nsfw: true` require confirmation before switching; cancelling keeps the current source. Recommendations, search, history, and cache identifiers for each source are isolated from one another, and switching saves progress and stops current playback. Recommendations in chat always exclude NSFW sources by default (including resumed playback). You can turn this off under Settings → Recommendation Settings by disabling “Always exclude NSFW sources”. Manually confirmed browsing of sources is not affected by this switch. This project is an unofficial, standalone plugin, and its icon is an original design. The red fruit echoes “Hongguo” (red fruit), while the leaf and play button form the plugin's own emblem. After installing and trusting the Hooks, send tasks as usual. The “Watch an episode while waiting” suggestions in chat recommend up to three shows per turn. Existing progress is shown first as “Continue watching”. When the current episode is finished and later episodes remain, “Watch next episode” is shown. Elsewhere, unwatched shows are rotated through, and clicking a show title opens the player in the current chat, starting playback according to the “Mute by default” setting. ## Installation and Configuration Supports macOS, Linux (x64/arm64), Windows x64, and Windows 11 ARM64. Requires Node.js >=22.16 (including npm) for the matching architecture. Choosing Codex also requires a Codex CLI that supports npm plugin sources. The playback components are prepared automatically by the plugin, so FFmpeg does not need to be installed separately. macOS / Linux, install with npm: ```sh npx "@kyun.si/codex-hongguo@latest" setup ``` Windows PowerShell: ```powershell npx.cmd "@kyun.si/codex-hongguo@latest" setup ```

# sapic

A self-hosted image host. The backend is an API-only Flask application (`server/`, package name `sapic`);
the front end is a separate Vue 3 single-page app (`web/`). Metadata lives in a relational database
(PostgreSQL / MySQL / SQLite), and **both storage backends and login methods are plugins**: a third-party
pip package can add a new object store or identity provider without touching the core.

> **Current version `2.0.0-pre.1` (the v2 rewrite)**
>
> The backend is now an API-only Flask app (Peewee + a relational database, no Redis), and the front end

xyzmean/ru-bypass-ipsets.description: Categorized IPv4 ipset lists for bypassing blocks (RF). Resolves domains to CIDR by category.
xyzmean/ru-bypass-ipsets.body:
# ru-bypass-ipsets

Categorized IPv4 ipset lists for bypassing blocks (RF). Resolves domains to CIDR by category and publishes ready-made `.lst` files for routing traffic through VPN/proxy.

The main consumer is [splify](https://github.com/xyzmean/splify) (OpenWrt). The format is compatible with `clean_ip_list`: strictly `A.B.C.D/N`, no bare IPs.

## Principle

1. **Sources** — vendor snapshots in the repo + reliable online APIs (`antifilter.download`, RIPEstat, Cloudflare/AWS CDN). The only access to a third-party repository is the ready-made Discord ipset (`1andrevich/Re-filter-lists`), and it has a snapshot in `sources/discord/`: an unavailable source does not wipe the list, but rolls it back to the last successful download.
2. **Resolution** — `dnspython` across 6 nameservers (including Yandex 77.88.8.8), merging A records from all resolvers for maximum CDN coverage.
3. **ASN pull** — for large services (Telegram, Meta, …) CIDRs are taken directly by ASN (RIPEstat → ip.guide → bgpview) and from CDN feeds (Cloudflare, CloudFront).
4. **Collapse** — `collapse_addresses()` merges overlaps and adjacent networks into the largest possible subnets; dedupe + sort.
5.
